append.detail: CLOSED 2026-10-20 at the two consequences the probe names. CRM is ONE module: modules/crm/index.ts and client.ts, with the 25 components moved under modules/crm/components (PROG-A1 and LIVE-1114), and the four route trees import only the barrel. Its data wall is pinned per table by supabase/tests/crm_tenant_wall.test.sql (RLS on, space_id stamped, no read policy that opens every row to anon) beside the behavioral cross-tenant proof in space_tenancy_walls.test.sql. Booking and email design have their barrels (LIVE-1114); they own no tables of their own to wall, so they get no enablement test of their own until one exists. CRM is gated by plan and role, not the default-on module switch of PROG-A3, which the test header says.
